_doc: Release config of orbit-mcp for the shared release kit (release/README.md): the Cloud Run services, the triggers, the smoke checks and the release check. Tier full: a merge deploys a no-traffic candidate revision of each service (dev stage), dev verify calls the candidate tag URLs, and the prod build moves the traffic to exactly those revisions. A failed release rolls back on its own. See docs/RELEASE_PIPELINE.md.
title: orbit-mcp

verify.log_filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name=("orbit-mcp" OR "orbit-profile-mcp") AND severity>=WARNING
